prompts.title: Batch day plan
prompts.summary: Plans five videos to film in one afternoon from your topics.
prompts.prompt: Plan a batch day for my [platform] channel about [topic]. I have [hours] and [locations]. Give five videos: the hook, three beats, the shot list, what to wear (one change at most) and the order to film them so I move as little as possible.
prompts.use: Film on Sunday, schedule all five.

prompts.title: Media kit
prompts.summary: A one-page media kit from your real numbers and the deals you want.
prompts.prompt: Write a one-page media kit for [channel]. Real numbers: followers per platform [ ], average views [ ], audience (age, location, top interests) [ ]. What I make: [ ]. Brands I'd fit: [ ]. Packages: [ ]. Contact: [ ]. Use only the numbers I gave you.
prompts.use: Update the numbers monthly. Send as a PDF.

prompts.title: One video, five pieces
prompts.summary: Cuts one long video into five short clips and a carousel, with timestamps.
prompts.prompt: Here's the transcript of my video with timestamps: [paste]. Find five 20 to 40-second clips that stand alone (give start and end times and a hook line for each) and turn the main point into a six-slide carousel.
prompts.use: Run it on every long video you post.
